No bug that would make the result meaningless. A shallower model running more steps in a fixed 300 s budget is a plausible source of a real gain.

This is consistent with a conservative noise model, not a mismatch in any claim.
The incumbent mean comes from only 1 run. A replicate of the incumbent would make the comparison more robust, but the gap (about 0.027) is large compared with typical run-to-run noise.
